name: Ravelry
description: The world's largest knitting and crochet community. Search patterns, track projects, join groups by interest or location.

name: r/knitting (Reddit)
description: Friendly Reddit community for knitters of all levels. Great for questions, showing off projects, and finding inspiration.

name: r/crochet (Reddit)
description: Active Reddit community for crocheters. Pattern sharing, troubleshooting, and plenty of 'finished object' posts to admire.

name: Knitting Paradise Forum
description: Bustling online forum for knitters and crocheters. Discussion boards, pattern links, and a warm community of mostly experienced crafters.

name: The Knitting Guild Association (TKGA)
description: National guild with a directory to find local knitting guilds near you. Great for finding in-person groups.

name: Meetup — Knitting Groups
description: Search for local knitting and crochet meetups in your area. Many cities have regular pub knitting nights and craft circles.

name: Knit & Natter UK
description: Network of informal knitting groups that meet in cafes, pubs, and community centres across the UK. Very welcoming to newcomers.

name: Craft Yarn Council
description: Industry group that promotes knitting and crochet. Offers certified instructor programs and resources for teaching others.

name: Lion Brand Yarn — Group Finder
description: Search tool to find knit and crochet clubs and groups in your area. User-submitted directory.

name: Crochet UK Facebook Group
description: Large Facebook group for UK-based crocheters. Pattern sharing, questions, and show-and-tell.

name: I Like Knitting — Guild Directory
description: Directory of knitting guilds and clubs organised by region. Helpful for finding established groups near you.

name: Stitch 'n Bitch Groups
description: Informal crafting circles inspired by the Stitch 'n Bitch book series. Many local groups worldwide — search for one near you.
